note: N. G. Wilson, Duckworth, 1983. Neither listed candidate book is this work.

note: Composed approximately 413–426. ISBN identifies the 2003 Penguin English translation by Henry Bettenson. No candidates supplied.

container: Karin D. Knorr-Cetina and Michael Mulkay (eds.), Science Observed: Perspectives on the Social Study of Science (Sage, 1983), pp. 141–170.

note: Edited by Peter G. B. McNeill and Hector L. MacQueen, not John MacQueen. This substantially expanded 1996 atlas revises the 1975 An Historical Atlas of Scotland c.400 to c.1600.

original_title: Orderly and Humane: The Expulsion of the Germans after the Second World War
note: R. M. Douglas, Yale University Press, 2012; publisher front matter confirms the original ISBN. No candidates supplied.

note: Shortened title of Valerie Yow’s article; not her book Recording Oral History or another candidate book.

original_title: Exorcising Hitler: The Occupation and Denazification of Germany
note: Frederick Taylor the historian. The candidate Principles of Scientific Management is by a different person, Frederick Winslow Taylor.

original_title: Consumers and Luxury: Consumer Culture in Europe 1650–1850
note: Edited by Maxine Berg and Helen Clifford, Manchester University Press, 1999. Distinct from the listed luxury books of 2003 and 2005.

original_title: The Age of Reagan: The Fall of the Old Liberal Order, 1964–1980
note: The 2009 paperback/ebook reissue of the 2001 first volume, matching w-386708. Not the separate second volume on 1980–1989.

note: Same Jane E. A. Dawson book, title and year; punctuation and capitalization vary.

id: W:ocallaghan|reconquest and crusade in medieval spain

note: Joseph F. O’Callaghan, University of Pennsylvania Press, 2003. No candidates supplied.

original_title: Reluctant Hosts: Anglo-Canadian Views of Multiculturalism in the Twentieth Century
container: Originally in Multiculturalism as State Policy: Report of the Second Canadian Conference on Multiculturalism (1976), pp. 81–118; reprinted in John R. Mallea and Jonathan C. Young (eds.), Cultural Diversity and Canadian Education (1984), pp. 21–40.
note: Howard H. Palmer essay, later reprinted in Francis and Smith’s Readings in Canadian History: Post-Confederation (1994), pp. 143–161. DOI confirmed from publisher-deposited Crossref metadata identifies the 1984 reprint; no candidate is this essay.

original_title: Efficiency and Uplift: Scientific Management in the Progressive Era, 1890–1920
note: Samuel Haber, University of Chicago Press, 1964. Distinct from the candidate The Quest for Authority and Honor.

note: Naomi Tadmor’s journal article. The related 2001 book Family and Friends in Eighteenth-Century England is a larger work, not an equivalent.

original_title: The Politics of Recognition
container: Amy Gutmann (ed.), Multiculturalism and “The Politics of Recognition” (Princeton University Press, 1992), pp. 25–73; reprinted in Multiculturalism: Examining the Politics of Recognition (1994), pp. 25–74.
note: Charles Taylor’s essay, first published in 1992. DOI identifies the cited 1994 chapter. Candidates w-322718 and w-322717 are the containing collections, not the individual essay.
